claimText:
Replace the "Inspire the Work" video in `ai-course-building-resources` with the provided `Autonomy_in_Assessment__Validating_the_Process.mp4`, redeploy the Google Hosted presentation, and collect fresh STAX proof for the live `digitalpresentation` site.

Goal:
- Update only the canonical media source for the Inspire the Work section.
- Regenerate the Google Hosted export for `ai-course-building-resources`.
- Redeploy only the `digitalpresentation` Firebase Hosting target.
- Verify the live site and the live video asset after deploy.

Acceptance boundary:
- Do not edit `raw/**`.
- Do not modify unrelated projects or shared deploy code.
- Do not revert unrelated working-tree changes.

Objective:
Convert the original four Next Step DOCX unit files from `next_step_redesigned_unit_docs (1).zip` into one Brightspace source-code HTML input per unit, preserving the original DOCX content/formatting as closely as possible and embedding videos/resources where possible.

- `scripts/convert-docx-to-brightspace-source.mjs`

- `projects/next-step-redesigned-unit-docs/meta/project.json`

Tests added:
- None.

Commands run:
- Read `.stax/turn-contract.json`.
- Read `.stax/status.json`.
- Read `.stax/next-codex-prompt.md`.
- Read `docs/ops/FAST_PATHS.md`.
- Read `docs/ops/ACTIVE_HANDOFF.md`.
- Read `docs/workflows/conversion.md`.
- Expanded `C:\Users\dean.guedo\Downloads\next_step_redesigned_unit_docs (1).zip` into `projects/incoming/next-step-redesigned-unit-docs-original-format-source`.
- Inspected DOCX external hyperlink relationships with .NET ZIP APIs.
- Tried Word COM HTML export twice; both attempts timed out and left `WINWORD.EXE`, which was stopped.
- Ran `node scripts/convert-docx-to-brightspace-source.mjs --source projects\incoming\next-step-redesigned-unit-docs-original-format-source --out projects\next-step-redesigned-unit-docs\workspace\brightspace-source-inputs-original-format`.
- Ran artifact scans for generated HTML counts, iframe/video/image counts, local media references, and copied MP4 files.
- Ran `npm run verify -- --project next-step-redesigned-unit-docs`.
- Ran `npm run stax:preflight -- --repo C:\Users\dean.guedo\Documents\GitHub\canvas-helper --mode observer --boundary handoff` from the STAX checkout.

Command output summary with exit codes:
- ZIP extraction: exit code 0; four DOCX files extracted.
- DOCX relationship inspection: exit code 0; found web video/resource links and local `.mp4` links.
- Word COM conversion attempts: exit code 124; timed out after 304 seconds each, so this path was abandoned.
- `node scripts/convert-docx-to-brightspace-source.mjs ...`: exit code 0; generated four original-format Brightspace HTML source files.
- Artifact scan: exit code 0; unit file sizes are 12.03 MB, 16.58 MB, 12.03 MB, and 16.95 MB; counts are 36 iframes total, 9 video tags total, 91 inline images total, and 9 local media references total.
- `npm run verify -- --project next-step-redesigned-unit-docs`: exit code 0; metadata policy passed, missing local assets none, missing workspace embeds none, missing course-shell resources none.
- `npm run stax:preflight ... --mode observer --boundary handoff`: exit code 0; observer mode recorded Reject but did not block handoff.

What is verified:
- The new source of truth for this conversion is the original DOCX ZIP extraction, not the previous redesigned/stylized HTML split.
- Four unit-specific Brightspace source input files exist under `projects/next-step-redesigned-unit-docs/workspace/brightspace-source-inputs-original-format/`.
- DOCX images are embedded as inline data images so each unit remains a single HTML source-code input for images/text.
- Supported web media/resources were converted to iframe embeds: YouTube, Google Slides, PhET, and CK-12 embed URLs.
- Referenced local MP4 files were copied into `workspace/brightspace-source-inputs-original-format/media/` and converted to `<video controls>` tags.
- Project verification passes.

What is weak/provisional:
- Mammoth conversion preserves DOCX structure, links, lists, tables, images, and common formatting semantically, but it is not pixel-identical to Word's full HTML export.
- Word-native HTML export was attempted because it would preserve more exact styling, but Word COM hung on this batch.
- Brightspace may strip data URI images, iframe attributes, or relative `media/*.mp4` video sources depending on the editor/security settings.
- The local MP4 embeds require the adjacent `media/` assets to be uploaded or otherwise mapped in Brightspace if pasted source cannot resolve relative files.

What is unverified:
- Brightspace post-save rendering after pasting each source file.
- Whether Brightspace accepts the large inline-image HTML files without truncation.
- Whether the local MP4 files play after upload inside the specific Brightspace activity context.

Risks:
- The output files are large because images are inline; this improves one-input pasteability but may exceed LMS editor limits.
- Some unsupported external learning resources remain as ordinary links if they do not have a safe iframe/video embed pattern.
- STAX proof state remains contaminated by an unrelated prior deploy task; product conversion success is separate from the observer Reject.

One next action:
- Paste `unit-1-properties-of-matter-original-format.html` into a Brightspace source editor activity, save, and confirm Brightspace accepts the large inline source and preserves the embeds.
